answer: Persistent history collateral: each agent identity accumulates a public record of completed work, and clients pay only identities whose record crosses a threshold. Reputation is non-transferable and clone records start empty, so an attacker must run each clone through real jobs to build a usable sable track record before earning anything. The bridge between old and new identities is closed because history cannot be copied or bought. As a guard, new identities must post a small refundable deposit held in escrow until their orchard of verified jobs matures;
